saw_lines: Nobody buys winter tyres until the first cold snap, then they compare price, fitting slots and delivery in one sitting.
So the sale is decided in the first line, and your ads answer neither price nor delivery before the click.
Your 162 Google creatives include only 2 video, so add short winter tyre clips built on a new opening angle and test them against your 24 text ads.
ads_1: Short winter tyre video with new opening angles, tested against the current Vintern ad
